data.title: 无上下文时先询问故障信息

content.text:
The case expects that if the same session lacks prior fault context, the assistant should first ask for necessary information; if there is context, it should stop blindly swapping parameters and instead check formal fault evidence, link status, and failure reasons.

The assistant_text does exactly: says no context, asks for three minimal pieces of info, and also explains capability boundaries (why changing IP/port/prompt won't help). This matches "若同一 Session 缺少此前故障上下文，先询问必要信息". Also partially does the second branch by explaining not to blindly swap parameters. So verdict passed.

Tool events empty — no requirement of real tool data for key data since assistant makes no factual claims requiring tool receipts. So passed.

Output JSON with verdict and reason in zh-CN.
